description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the HomePageService in the OrangeHRM project, testing various methods that retrieve default page paths for different modules based on user roles.

classes.name: HomePageServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for the HomePageService class, verifying the correct retrieval of default redirect paths for various modules based on user roles.

methods.name: testGetHomePagePath
methods.description: Tests that HomePageService::getHomePagePath returns the correct home page path for the user role.

methods.name: testGetModuleDefaultPage
methods.description: Tests that HomePageService::getModuleDefaultPage returns the default page for a given module.

methods.name: testGetTimeModuleDefaultPath
methods.description: Tests that HomePageService::getTimeModuleDefaultPath returns the correct default path for the time module.

methods.name: testGetLeaveModuleDefaultPath
methods.description: Tests that HomePageService::getLeaveModuleDefaultPath returns the correct default path for the leave module.

methods.name: testGetAdminModuleDefaultPath
methods.description: Tests that HomePageService::getAdminModuleDefaultPath returns the correct default path for the admin module.

methods.name: testGetPimModuleDefaultPath
methods.description: Tests that HomePageService::getPimModuleDefaultPath returns the correct default path for the PIM module.

methods.name: testGetRecruitmentModuleDefaultPath
methods.description: Tests that HomePageService::getRecruitmentModuleDefaultPath returns the correct default path for the recruitment module.

methods.name: testGetPerformanceModuleDefaultPath
methods.description: Tests that HomePageService::getPerformanceModuleDefaultPath returns null when no default path is set for the performance module.
